# Gelabber v0.10.2

Integrated through #564, #568 (#561), #569 (#538), #562 and #582 to #586
into `v0.10`, Dependabot's #559 on `main`, and the version PR into `main`.

A small release for the clients and the repository. **Fields**: every
input, text area and select in the browser and the desktop app now has one
look and one focus style, so a focused field shows a single frame instead
of two, and the search no longer shows a box inside its frame.
**Entdecken** no longer offers the previous search's next page. There is
no database migration, and `compose.yaml` changes only its image pins, so
`.env` needs no edit and going back to v0.10.1 needs only the old image
set.

## Fields (#561, browser and app)

- **One frame in focus.** A focused field showed its own coloured border
  and the page-wide focus ring around it. Now the border takes the focus
  colour and a flush 1 px ring sits on it, with no gap (WCAG 2.2 2.4.13);
  an invalid field rings in the danger colour. In Windows High Contrast
  (forced colors) the system draws the outline.
- **No box in the search.** The chat header search painted a square,
  page-coloured box inside its rounded frame; the desktop app had copied
  it. Both are gone, the clear button stays (#564).
- **One look.** Every field uses the panel colour and the medium radius of
  the search and the composer. Before, form fields (settings and
  dialogs) used the page colour and the small radius, so they look a little
  rounder and sit on the panel colour now.
- **The same fields everywhere:** header search, composer, message edit,
  emoji and GIF picker search and select, the invite link fields, the theme
  editor's fields and its colour pickers (no inner box any more), and the
  public feedback form. Settings cards ring only once.
- **Buttons inside fields** (the composer's buttons, the password eye) ring
  along their own edge. The desktop composer's buttons had no focus ring
  before; keyboard users now see which one has focus.
- Web and desktop take the field colours from the same theme tokens, for
  all 14 presets.

## Entdecken (#538, browser)

- **"Mehr laden" waits for the new search.** While a new search loaded, the
  page kept the previous search's rows and offered its next page, which
  then landed in the new search. The button now appears once the new
  search's results are in, as in the desktop app.

## Browser dependencies (#559)

- zustand 5.1.0, Tailwind CSS and `@tailwindcss/vite` 4.3.5. Nothing
  visible changes.

## Upgrade notes

- The image pins `GELABBER_{API,WEB,MEDIA}_IMAGE` move together to
  `v0.10.2`. `compose.yaml` changes only these pins; the API and media
  images carry no code change besides the version.
- **No migration**, no new `.env` variable, no new setting.
- **Rollback:** the v0.10.1 image set. v0.10.1 runs on the same database.
- **Order:** any. 0.10.1 apps and 0.10.2 servers work together in both
  directions; nothing in the API changed.
- **Desktop:** Windows offers the update itself; Arch: `pacman -Syu`.

## CI and repository

- **Picture tests for fields** (#568): `npm run test:field-gallery`
  screenshots every field idle and in keyboard focus in four themes and
  compares it with a baseline (60 pictures, in the Frontend CI job, which
  uploads the pictures of any mismatch). The desktop draws the same states
  with `egui_kittest` (52 pictures). A token test makes web and desktop
  fail when their theme tokens drift apart. ESLint forbids raw text
  `<input>`, `<textarea>` and `<select>` outside `components/ui`.
- **Parity scenes** (#538): `settings-konto-delete` signs in as Kai, who owns
  no server, `invite-invalid(-en)` sign in as Lena and show the
  dead invite in both clients, `setup-dark` is dropped (the setup page is
  always dark), and the user-menu scenes run as the desktop app.
- **Planning** (#562): `AGENTS.md` has a Planning section (issue first,
  assignee, one milestone per release with its goal, `Closes #<n>`) and the
  branch naming rule (`<type>/<issue>-<short-description>`,
  `release/vX.Y.Z`, `hotfix/…`, `sync/main-into-vX.Y`). Bug and feature
  issue forms set the issue type.
- **Claude Code setup** (#582 to #586): a setup script for cloud sessions
  (`.claude/cloud-setup.sh`), a hook that blocks pushes of branch names
  outside the rule, a Stop hook that runs the fast checks for changed files,
  the CI workflow rules loaded only for workflow changes
  (`.claude/rules/ci-workflows.md`), and repository skills for releases,
  test services and native parity (`.claude/skills/`).

## Open

- The field changes were checked by their picture tests and in Chromium,
  not on real devices and not in Windows High Contrast on real hardware.
- The web field baselines come from Chromium 1243; CI runs 1254 and passed.
- Whether the setup page should follow the system's light or dark scheme
  stays a product question (#538).
